tasks.label: pylance: clean-cache
args: Write-Host '🧹 Limpiando caché de análisis...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; $vscodePath = [Environment]::GetFolderPath('ApplicationData') + '\.vscode'; if (Test-Path $vscodePath) { Get-ChildItem $vscodePath -Filter '*pylance*' -Recurse | Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Write-Host '✅ Caché limpio' -ForegroundColor Green

tasks.label: PPO Training v7.1 with Live Monitoring
tasks.command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$env:PYTHONIOENCODING='utf-8'; Write-Host '═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host 'PPO TRAINING v7.1 - VecNormalize Attribute Bypass Fix' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host '═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host ''; python scripts/train/train_ppo_multiobjetivo.py 2>&1"

tasks.label: PPO Training - Complete Pipeline
args: $env:PYTHONIOENCODING='utf-8'; Write-Host '═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host 'FASE 3/3: ENTRENAR PPO - COMPLETE PIPELINE' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host '═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host ''; Write-Host 'Checkpoints: Limpios ✓ | Datasets: Validados ✓ | Iniciando...'; Write-Host ''; python scripts/train/train_ppo_multiobjetivo.py 2>&1
